title: Setup check screen
story: I opened Grillo for the first time and it told me exactly which tool was missing and what to type to sign in. After I signed in to GitHub and pressed Check again, everything turned green and it showed my login, name and email. Below that I could choose whether Grillo and its speech model update themselves, and take a new version with one click.

checks.criterion: Each tool's status and guidance; 'Open install guide' opens the guide
checks.steps: On a laptop without Claude Code or gh, open Grillo.
checks.expected: A red note says Grillo needs two tools; both rows say 'Not found' with install steps; the GitHub account row says 'Waits for gh'; Continue is locked; 'Open install guide' opens the guide in the browser.

checks.criterion: A signed-out tool shows its sign-in command; Check again forces a fresh check
checks.steps: With gh installed, run gh auth logout and open Grillo. Then run gh auth login --web and press Check again.
checks.expected: First gh shows Installed / Signed out with gh auth login --web; after Check again all rows are green and Continue unlocks.

checks.criterion: When signed in, the screen shows the identity
checks.steps: Sign in to both tools with a test account and open Grillo.
checks.expected: A table with login, name and email; Continue opens the Project screen.

checks.criterion: The one-time email step appears when GitHub shares no email
checks.steps: Sign in with a plain gh auth login (no user:email scope) on an account with a private email, then open Grillo.
checks.expected: Email 'Not shared yet', the command gh auth refresh -h github.com -s user:email, a Check again button, and Continue still enabled.

checks.steps: Turn on 'Install automatically on the next restart', pick 'Never' for speech model updates, restart Grillo.
checks.expected: Both choices are kept; settings.json holds autoUpdate true and speechModelUpdates never.

checks.criterion: The update card offers Download and install and Later
checks.steps: In an installed build older than the latest release, open Grillo.
checks.expected: 'Grillo X is available. You have Y.' with both buttons; Download shows progress then restarts into the new version; Later hides the offer.

checks.criterion: On an unsigned Mac, Download and install opens the release page
checks.steps: On an unsigned Mac build with an update offered, press Download and install.
checks.expected: The card explains the manual install and the latest-release page opens in the browser.
